a precipitation disc at the pad 8 to 14 h ahead was accepted by the field (ISurfaceForcing); without it the alert rows have no storm to jump over
the engine's ETA search found the forced storm at the pad
the ETA of the user's level (Heavy) lies within the forced window
a scripted UT jump across the storm's ETA (past the Approaching and the Arrived time) produces exactly one message
that one message is the summary of the jump (it names the events and says it passed during time warp)
the stock message app received one message for the jump (alertMessageApp on)
the same UT set again delivers nothing; this alone cannot fail through the delivery's memory, the rows below test the reload
a rewind to the time before the forced storm (a reload to an earlier save) delivers nothing by itself: the storm lies ahead
forward over the storm again after the rewind: the event lies ahead again, so it is delivered again, once (the rule of AlertDelivery: a rewind forgets the keys of events after the new time)
